# GateCtr — Complete Documentation

> GateCtr is an LLM gateway that sits between your app and any LLM provider. One endpoint swap gives you cost control, smart routing, prompt compression, and real-time analytics.

Base API URL: https://api.gatectr.com/v1
Dashboard: https://app.gatectr.com
Authentication: Bearer token — header `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`

---

# Introduction

GateCtr sits between your app and any LLM provider. One endpoint swap. No code changes. Full control over costs, routing, and observability.

What you get:
- -40% tokens — Context Optimizer compresses prompts automatically
- Budget Firewall — Hard caps per project. No surprise invoices.
- Model Router — GateCtr picks the right LLM for each request
- Analytics — Every token, every cost, real-time
- Webhooks — Push events to Slack, Teams, or any URL
- RBAC — Team access control with roles

---

# Authentication

All API requests require a GateCtr API key passed as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer gct_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Key formats:
- `gct_live_` prefix — Production (real LLM calls, real costs)
- `gct_test_` prefix — Test mode (mock responses, no costs)

Get your key: sign in at gatectr.com → Settings → API Keys → Create key.

Security: Never commit API keys to source control. Use environment variables. Rotate keys regularly. LLM provider keys are AES-256 encrypted at rest.

On auth failure: HTTP 401 with `{"error": {"type": "unauthorized", "message": "Invalid or missing API key."}}`

---

# Quickstart

1. Get your API key from https://app.gatectr.com
2. Install the SDK: `npm install @gatectr/sdk` or `pip install gatectr-sdk`
3. Make your first request:

Node.js:
```typescript
import { GateCtr } from '@gatectr/sdk';
const client = new GateCtr({ apiKey: process.env.GATECTR_API_KEY });
const response = await client.complete({
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }],
});
console.log(response.choices[0].text);
console.log(response.gatectr.tokensSaved);
console.log(response.gatectr.modelUsed);
console.log(response.gatectr.latencyMs);
```

Python:
```python
import os
from gatectr import GateCtr
client = GateCtr(api_key=os.environ["GATECTR_API_KEY"])
response = await client.complete(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].text)
```

Drop-in for OpenAI SDK (no code changes needed):
```typescript
import OpenAI from 'openai';
const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.GATECTR_API_KEY,
  baseURL: 'https://api.gatectr.com/v1',
});
```

---

# Request Lifecycle

```
Your app
  → GateCtr API (https://api.gatectr.com/v1/complete)
    → 1. Budget Firewall check        (blocks if limit exceeded → 429)
    → 2. Context Optimizer            (compresses prompt → fewer tokens)
    → 3. Model Router                 (selects best model if route: true)
    → 4. LLM provider                 (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Gemini…)
    → 5. Response + analytics logged  (tokens, cost, latency stored)
  → Your app                          (response + GateCtr headers)
```

Steps 2 and 3 are optional but enabled by default on Pro plans. If budget is exceeded at step 1, no LLM call is made and no cost is incurred.

Supported models: OpenAI (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo), Anthropic (claude-3-5-sonnet, claude-3-opus, claude-3-haiku), Mistral (mistral-large, mistral-medium, mistral-small), Google Gemini (gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash), Meta Llama (llama-3.1-70b, llama-3.1-8b).

Use `model: "auto"` to let the Model Router pick automatically.

---

# API Reference

## POST /v1/complete

Send a text completion request through GateCtr.

Endpoint: `POST https://api.gatectr.com/v1/complete`

Required headers:
- `Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>`
- `Content-Type: application/json`

Request body parameters:
- `model` (string, required): Model name or "auto" for Model Router
- `messages` (array, required): OpenAI-compatible messages array with `role` and `content`
- `temperature` (number, optional, default 1.0): Sampling temperature 0–2
- `max_tokens` (number, optional): Maximum completion tokens
- `stream` (boolean, optional, default false): Enable streaming via SSE
- `optimize` (boolean, optional, default true): Enable Context Optimizer (Pro+)
- `route` (boolean, optional, default false): Enable Model Router (Pro+)
- `budgetId` (string, optional): Override the active project budget

Response:
```json
{
  "id": "cmpl-abc123",
  "object": "text_completion",
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "choices": [{"text": "Hello! How can I help you?", "finish_reason": "stop"}],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 9, "total_tokens": 21, "saved_tokens": 8},
  "gatectr": {"requestId": "req_abc123", "latencyMs": 342, "overage": false, "modelUsed": "gpt-4o", "tokensSaved": 8}
}
```

Response headers: `X-GateCtr-Request-Id`, `X-GateCtr-Latency-Ms`, `X-GateCtr-Overage`

Streaming: When `stream: true`, returns SSE chunks: `{"id":"cmpl-abc123","delta":"Hello","finishReason":null}`

Error codes: 400 bad_request, 401 unauthorized, 422 validation_error, 429 budget_exceeded, 429 rate_limit_exceeded, 502 provider_error, 503 service_unavailable

## POST /v1/chat

Chat completion endpoint. Returns responses in `choices[].message` format.

Endpoints:
- `POST https://api.gatectr.com/v1/chat` — native GateCtr endpoint
- `POST https://api.gatectr.com/v1/chat/completions` — OpenAI-compatible alias

Same request parameters as /v1/complete.

Response:
```json
{
  "id": "chat-abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello! How can I help you?"}, "finish_reason": "stop"}],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 9, "total_tokens": 21, "saved_tokens": 8},
  "gatectr": {"requestId": "req_abc123", "latencyMs": 342, "overage": false, "modelUsed": "gpt-4o", "tokensSaved": 8}
}
```

Compatible with OpenAI SDK, LangChain, and LlamaIndex by pointing `baseURL` to `https://api.gatectr.com/v1`.

## GET /v1/usage

Query token usage and cost data for a project.

Endpoint: `GET https://api.gatectr.com/v1/usage`

Query parameters:
- `from` (string, optional): Start date YYYY-MM-DD
- `to` (string, optional): End date YYYY-MM-DD
- `projectId` (string, optional): Filter by project ID

Response:
```json
{
  "totalTokens": 4820000,
  "totalRequests": 12400,
  "totalCostUsd": 14.23,
  "savedTokens": 1920000,
  "from": "2025-01-01",
  "to": "2025-01-31",
  "byProject": [
    {"projectId": "proj_123", "totalTokens": 2900000, "totalRequests": 7400, "totalCostUsd": 8.55}
  ]
}
```

---

# Features

## Context Optimizer

Compresses prompts by up to 40% before forwarding to the LLM. Preserves all semantic meaning and code blocks.

Techniques: removes redundant whitespace and filler phrases, condenses verbose instructions, trims conversation history to most relevant turns, deduplicates repeated context.

Enable per request: set `optimize: true` in request body or `gatectr.optimize: true` in SDK.
Enable globally: set `optimize: true` in SDK constructor.
Disable for specific request: set `optimize: false` (recommended for structured output, JSON mode, function calling, carefully tuned few-shot examples).

Savings example: RAG app with 3,350 tokens → ~2,010 tokens after optimization → ~$0.04 saved per request. At 10,000 requests/day: ~$400/day savings.

Available on Pro plan and above.

## Budget Firewall

Hard token and cost caps per project. Blocks requests the moment a limit is hit — no LLM call made, no cost incurred.

Flow: Request → Budget Firewall check → Under limit: forward to LLM → Over limit: 429 Budget Exceeded

Set budget via dashboard (Projects → Your project → Budget) or via API:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.gatectr.com/v1/budget \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATECTR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"project_id": "proj_123", "limit_tokens": 100000, "period": "day"}'
```

Budget types:
- `limit_tokens`: Cap on total tokens (prompt + completion)
- `limit_cost_usd`: Cap on estimated USD cost

Periods: `day` (resets midnight UTC), `month` (resets 1st of month), `total` (lifetime, manual reset)

Soft alerts: set `alert_at_percent` to receive a webhook before the hard cap. Example: `"alert_at_percent": 80` fires `budget.threshold_reached` webhook at 80% usage.

Override budget per request: use `gatectr.budgetId` to apply a different project's budget.

Blocked request response: HTTP 429 with `{"error": {"type": "budget_exceeded", "message": "Request blocked. Budget limit reached."}}`

Available on Free plan and above.

## Model Router

Automatically selects the best and cheapest LLM for each request based on task complexity, output requirements, current model pricing, provider preferences, and latency requirements.

Enable options:
1. Set `model: "auto"` in request
2. Set `route: true` in request body or `gatectr.route: true` in SDK
3. Set `route: true` globally in SDK constructor

Routing logic:
- Simple Q&A, short tasks → gpt-3.5-turbo, mistral-small
- Summarization, classification → gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-haiku
- Complex reasoning, analysis → gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet
- Code generation, debugging → gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet
- Long-form writing → gpt-4o, mistral-large

Configure in dashboard: Settings → Model Router (allow list, block list, cost threshold, latency mode).

After routing, `response.gatectr.modelUsed` tells you which model handled the request.

Available on Pro plan and above.

## Analytics

Every request is logged automatically: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, saved_tokens, model, latency_ms, project_id, timestamp, overage.

Dashboard at app.gatectr.com: overview, by project, trends (7d/30d/90d), optimization savings.

Query via API: GET /v1/usage with optional projectId, from, to parameters.

Data retention: Free 7 days, Pro 30 days, Team 90 days, Enterprise custom.

## Webhooks

Receive real-time notifications at any HTTPS endpoint when events happen.

Supported events:
- Billing: billing.plan_upgraded, billing.plan_downgraded, billing.payment_failed, billing.trial_started, billing.trial_ending, billing.subscription_cancellation_scheduled
- Budget: budget.threshold_reached, budget.exceeded, budget.reset
- Requests: request.completed, request.failed, request.routed
- Provider: provider.fallback, provider.error
- API Keys: api_key.created, api_key.revoked, api_key.expired
- Projects: project.created
- Team: team.member.added, team.member.removed
- Usage: usage.daily
- Webhook meta: webhook.test, webhook.failed

Register via dashboard (Settings → Webhooks → Add endpoint) or API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.gatectr.com/v1/webhooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATECTR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"name": "My endpoint", "url": "https://your-app.com/webhooks/gatectr", "events": ["budget.threshold_reached"]}'
```

URL must use HTTPS. Use `"events": ["*"]` for wildcard subscription.

Payload format:
```json
{"event": "billing.plan_upgraded", "project_id": "usr_abc123", "timestamp": "2026-03-26T10:00:00.000Z", "data": {"previous_plan": "PRO", "new_plan": "TEAM"}}
```

Signature verification: `X-GateCtr-Signature: hmac-sha256=<hex>` computed over raw request body using your `whsec_…` secret. Always use timing-safe comparison.

Retry policy: up to 6 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s). 4xx errors fail immediately (except 429). Auto-disabled after 10 consecutive failures.

Available on Pro plan and above.

---

# Node.js SDK (@gatectr/sdk)

Install: `npm install @gatectr/sdk`

Constructor options: apiKey (required), baseUrl, timeout (default 30000ms), maxRetries (default 3), route (default false), optimize (default true)

Methods:
- `client.complete(params)` — text completion, returns `CompleteResponse`
- `client.chat(params)` — chat completion, returns `ChatResponse`
- `client.stream(params)` — streaming chat, returns `AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>`
- `client.models()` — list available models
- `client.usage(params)` — query usage analytics

GateCtrMetadata fields on every response:
- `requestId` (string): unique request ID
- `latencyMs` (number): end-to-end latency
- `overage` (boolean): whether budget cap was exceeded
- `modelUsed` (string): actual model used
- `tokensSaved` (number): tokens saved by optimizer

Error classes: GateCtrError, GateCtrApiError (status, code, requestId), GateCtrConfigError, GateCtrTimeoutError (timeoutMs), GateCtrStreamError, GateCtrNetworkError

Drop-in for OpenAI SDK: set `baseURL: 'https://api.gatectr.com/v1'` and use your GateCtr API key.

---

# Python SDK (gatectr-sdk)

Install: `pip install gatectr-sdk` or `uv add gatectr-sdk`. Requires Python 3.9+.

Constructor options: api_key (required), base_url, timeout (default 30.0s), max_retries (default 3), route (default False), optimize (default True)

All methods are async. Use `SyncGateCtr` for synchronous code.

Methods:
- `await client.complete(model, messages, ...)` — text completion
- `await client.chat(model, messages, ...)` — chat completion
- `async for chunk in client.stream(model, messages, ...)` — streaming
- `await client.models()` — list available models
- `await client.usage(UsageParams(...))` — query usage analytics

GateCtrMetadata fields: request_id, latency_ms, overage, model_used, tokens_saved

Exception classes: GateCtrError, GateCtrApiError (status, code, request_id), GateCtrConfigError, GateCtrTimeoutError (timeout_s), GateCtrStreamError, GateCtrNetworkError

Drop-in for OpenAI SDK: set `base_url="https://api.gatectr.com/v1"` and use your GateCtr API key.
Drop-in for LangChain: use `ChatOpenAI(api_key=..., base_url="https://api.gatectr.com/v1", model="gpt-4o")`
Drop-in for LlamaIndex: use `OpenAI(api_key=..., api_base="https://api.gatectr.com/v1", model="gpt-4o")`
